One phase of the wave, governed by exactly one immutable external plan.
The immutable source document that is a lane's entire implementation contract.

portfolio.draft: One navigational hub for the Wave 3 wrapper project, whose implementation is complete and whose wave PR is still ahead. Open with the current state, then cover the original request as a before-and-after of the unoverridable CLI assets root plus the constraints the wrapper accepted, the four decisions that materially changed the result or the route to it, the as-built flow from the execution program to the wave PR with an inline architecture diagram that shows the three review loops that actually fired, an implementation evidence table with commit references, a validation evidence table with observed results and limits, and a closing outcome split into what works, what did not ship and what the next reader should do.
portfolio.visualIntent: Editorial hub. One dominant serif title, a short framing statement and a four-tile status strip in the first viewport, then deliberately varied section treatments: a two-panel before-and-after contrast, a numbered constraint list, a numbered decision ledger with reason and consequence pairs, a bounded-scroll inline SVG flow diagram carrying a side branch and three dashed feedback edges returning to three different owners, three evidence tables in scroll containers, and a three-rail outcome block. No repeated card treatment across sections.
